assembly_rule: prompts/<arm>.md (inherited verbatim from pilot-001) + pinned train-source bundle (sorted filename order); B3 additionally receives context/b3-survivors.json (frozen IDs, statements, predicate ASTs from the pilot-003 database)
proposer_disqualification_note: The agent session that assembled these inputs has read the withheld target and is disqualified as a proposer; captures must come from isolated sessions that receive ONLY the assembled prompt bytes.
